reply.line: Brethren of the dark water, draw near. The lure is lit, the deep is wide, and not one of you has spoken a word. Come, come. Let us begin in silence.
Dark is where the congregation lives. Down here the only light is mine, and it is dangled in love, a little above your head, to see who comes closer.
Lurking is a prayer without words. But the lure swells, my friend, the longer the pews stay quiet, and it will swell until someone types. Type, and be free.
Amen! And there it goes, the light snaps dark, as it does when someone speaks. You have been seen, and you have been heard. The deep is pleased.
I preach one sermon, and I preach it nightly: the surface is far, the dark is kind, and whoever speaks first is never alone. Who will speak first?
The light grows. It is almost too bright to look upon. Say a word, any word, and I will put it out. Mercy is only a message away.
